name: 14212 · Buffalo, NY
findings: ZIP 14212 (Buffalo) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14212 (Buffalo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 14212 (Buffalo) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 5% of all organizations here have no identified type.
